risks.risk: Brakes may be worn or not properly adjusted (pads/cables/calipers not visible).
risks.proof: Short video of a safe stop test + close-up of both front and rear brake pads/cables (or calipers) showing thickness and alignment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used bicycles with brakes not guaranteed (worst case: needs adjustment/parts).

risks.risk: Gears may skip or shift poorly under load (derailleur/shifter condition not visible).

risks.if_unproven: Price as used bicycles with gears not guaranteed (worst case: needs tuning).

risks.risk: Hidden rust/corrosion in chain, hubs, spokes, and under-frame areas.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of chain, rear cassette/freewheel area, wheel hubs, and underside of frame.

risks.risk: Tires/tubes may be near end-of-life or have slow leaks.
